feature: the design at a glance (Etsy first photo: one product, no text)
prompt: The ring stands upright on the pale travertine surface, seen from a three-quarter front angle a little above it. The round stone faces the camera on the part of the band nearest the lens, sitting on the thin bright groove; the bright bevels outline both edges of the band, and the full circle of the band is visible, nothing cut off. The ring sits in the centre of the frame and fills a little more than half of the frame's height, with generous space on the left and right so that a square crop keeps the whole ring. A soft amber patch of light lies on the plaster wall behind it and a faint teal patch on the travertine to one side. The ring is the only object in the image. The ring: a solid 14K yellow gold band, 6 mm wide and 1.5 mm thick, with a flat outer face. Along each edge of the band the outer corner is cut away at an angle into a narrow, high-polish bevel about 0.7 mm wide, so a thin bright line frames the face along both edges, all the way round. Between the two bevels the face has a fine, even brushed satin finish, its soft grain running around the band. One thin, high-polish groove, a fine bright line about 0.3 mm wide, runs all the way around the band parallel to its edges, a little off centre: the brushed strip on one side of it is about one and a half times as wide as the strip on the other side. The inside of the band is smooth high polish. One single round brilliant lab-grown diamond, bright and colourless, about 2 mm across, so its diameter is about one third of the band's width. It sits directly on the groove, centred on it, and the groove runs into its rim from both sides. It is set flush: its top is level with the brushed face, held by a fine polished gold rim cut into the band, with no claws. It is the only stone on the ring: no other diamonds, no pave, no prongs, no claws, no raised bezel or collet standing above the surface, no engraving, no hallmark, no text. Setting: a natural home studio in soft late-afternoon daylight from a large window, with a warm ivory lime-plaster wall, pale travertine and light oak surfaces, and undyed natural linen. Gentle patches of coloured light fall across the surfaces nearby, honey amber and soft teal, cast by sunlight through coloured glass outside the frame. Controlled metal reflections: the metal shows broad, soft reflections with no blown-out highlights, no hard white streaks and no mirror-chrome look, and it keeps its true natural colour, never orange or over-saturated. A diamond in view may catch a small flash of the amber or teal light. Photorealistic product photograph, natural colour, sharp focus on the jewellery, gentle shallow depth of field. No text, no logo, no watermark, no packaging. Reference images: both show this ring's design.
